name: EU Cyber Resilience Act, Annex I
description: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847. Essential cybersecurity requirements (Part I) and vulnerability handling requirements (Part II) for manufacturers of products with digital elements. Paddock evidence applies to the product only where the SBOM projects and observed devices are the manufacturer's product (firmware, companion apps, cloud back-end). Reporting of actively exploited vulnerabilities (Article 14) is listed for completeness.

controls.title: Cybersecurity appropriate to the risks
controls.summary: Products are designed, developed and produced to ensure an appropriate level of cybersecurity based on the risks.
controls.rationale: Requires the manufacturer's cybersecurity risk assessment.
controls.attestation: Provide the cybersecurity risk assessment in the technical documentation.

controls.title: No known exploitable vulnerabilities at release
controls.summary: Made available on the market without known exploitable vulnerabilities.
controls.rationale: Open KEV findings and critical component vulnerabilities in the SBOM are gaps; Paddock cannot confirm the state of each released version.
controls.attestation: Confirm the vulnerability status of each release placed on the market.

controls.title: Secure by default configuration
controls.summary: Made available with a secure by default configuration, with the possibility to reset to the original state.
controls.rationale: Observed configuration of deployed units only.
controls.attestation: Document default configuration and reset capability.

controls.title: Vulnerabilities can be addressed through security updates
controls.summary: Vulnerabilities can be addressed through security updates, including automatic updates where applicable.
controls.rationale: The update mechanism is a product design property.
controls.attestation: Describe the update mechanism and its defaults.

controls.title: Protection from unauthorised access
controls.summary: Ensure protection from unauthorised access by appropriate control mechanisms.
controls.rationale: Exposed admin surfaces, default logins and leaked credentials are detected on the product's observable interfaces.
controls.attestation: Document authentication and access control design.

controls.title: Confidentiality of data
controls.summary: Protect the confidentiality of stored, transmitted or otherwise processed data, e.g. by encryption.
controls.rationale: Data in transit on observed interfaces only; data at rest is not observable.

controls.title: Limited attack surface
controls.summary: Designed, developed and produced to limit attack surfaces, including external interfaces.
controls.rationale: Measures the externally observable attack surface and paths through it.

controls.title: Security-relevant activity is recorded and monitored
controls.summary: Provide security related information by recording and monitoring relevant internal activity, with an opt-out for users.
controls.rationale: A product logging capability; Paddock's audit log is not the product's.

controls.title: Identify and document components and vulnerabilities (SBOM)
controls.summary: Identify and document vulnerabilities and components, including an SBOM in a commonly used, machine-readable format covering at least top-level dependencies.
controls.rationale: Paddock maintains a machine-readable SBOM per project with direct (top-level) and transitive dependencies, continuously matched to OSV. Ensure the projects analysed are the shipped product.

controls.title: Address and remediate vulnerabilities without delay
controls.summary: Address and remediate vulnerabilities without delay, including by providing security updates.
controls.rationale: SLA-tracked remediation from detection to verified fix.

controls.title: Effective and regular security tests and reviews
controls.summary: Apply effective and regular tests and reviews of the security of the product.
controls.rationale: Automated SAST/SCA and external scanning are regular tests; manual reviews and penetration tests are not evidenced.

controls.title: Publicly disclose fixed vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Once an update is available, share and publicly disclose information about fixed vulnerabilities.
controls.rationale: Advisory publication is a manufacturer process.

controls.title: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy
controls.summary: Put in place and enforce a policy on coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

controls.title: Contact address for reporting vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Facilitate sharing of information about potential vulnerabilities, including a contact address.

controls.title: Secure distribution of updates
controls.summary: Provide mechanisms to securely distribute updates so vulnerabilities are fixed in a timely manner.
controls.attestation: Describe the signed update distribution mechanism.

controls.title: Security updates disseminated without delay
controls.summary: Disseminate available security updates without delay and free of charge, with advisory messages.
controls.rationale: Remediation timeliness supports this; dissemination to users is a manufacturer process.
controls.attestation: Provide update release and notification records.

controls.title: Report actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents
controls.summary: Notify actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents to the designated CSIRT and ENISA (early warning within 24 hours).
controls.rationale: KEV and threat-intel matching help detect active exploitation affecting the product; the notification itself is a manufacturer duty.
controls.attestation: Provide the reporting procedure and any notifications made.
